name: Lanternfall: The Brindle Ford Trials
author: Browser-RPG Developers
description: The developer campaign. Sit the Wayfarers' Guild trials in the river town of Brindle Ford, then relight the dark lighthouse on Gull Rock before the sea fog swallows the coast. Short, varied and built to touch every system in the engine: combat, confrontations, crafting, minigames, riddles, trade, companions, the law, timed quests, moral choices and more.
startingJournalNotes: Arrived in Brindle Ford to sit the Wayfarers' Guild trials. Examiner Odile Marsh has the Trial Ledger. Everyone keeps talking about the dark lighthouse on Gull Rock.

easy.label: Easy (Story)
easy.desc: Unlimited respawns at the Willowmere Apiary. Nothing is lost when you fall.

normal.label: Normal
normal.desc: Unlimited respawns; you lose 5 drachmae and up to a quarter of your loose supplies when you fall.

hard.label: Hard (3 lives)
hard.desc: Three respawns, then the hero is gone for good. Up to half your loose supplies are lost each time.

extreme.label: Extreme (One life)
extreme.desc: No respawns. Falling once ends the run.

factions.name: Brindle Folk
factions.description: Ferry crews, stallholders and families of Brindle Ford.

factions.name: The Ford Watch
factions.description: Captain Garrow's watchmen. They keep the toll, the peace and the cells.

factions.name: Wayfarers' Guild
factions.description: Licensed guides, couriers and monster-hunters. You want to join them.

factions.name: Hive Sisters of Willowmere
factions.description: Beekeepers, healers and keepers of the Hive Mother's shrine.

factions.name: Saltreed Smugglers
factions.description: Jory Vane's crew, running brandy and secrets through the cove.

defeatNarrative: You wake on a cot that smells of beeswax. The Hive Sisters found you and carried you to Willowmere.

timeOfDayNarration.Morning: Mist lifts off the river and the ferry bell rings for the first crossing.
timeOfDayNarration.Afternoon: Gulls wheel over the reeds and the market is loud with haggling.
timeOfDayNarration.Dusk: Lamps are lit along the ford. Out at sea, Gull Rock stays dark.
timeOfDayNarration.Night: Sea fog rolls inland. Somewhere a bell tolls that nobody is ringing.

hydra_bane.name: Monster Hunter
hydra_bane.desc: +2 bonus damage on melee attacks against beasts and monsters.

success.text: They laugh, clap you on the shoulder and tell everyone how sensible you are.

failure.text: You mispronounce their name twice. They will remember.

tactics.label: Blow the Guild whistle
tactics.desc: A shrill blast that rattles anything with ears.
tactics.text: The whistle shrieks. Your foe flinches and loses its rhythm.

campEvents.text: Far out at sea a bell tolls three times. You lie awake listening, and somehow feel braver for it (+2 on your next check).
A family of otters raids your pack and makes off with some food.
A pedlar with a lantern shares your fire and gossip from the road.
The fog soaks through your blanket. You wake stiff and cold.
Raking the embers in the morning you find someone's lost coins.

careful.label: Watchful
careful.desc: Slower; you read the reeds and spot trouble first.

stalk.title: The Reed Stalk
stalk.subtitle: Creep through the reeds while the wind covers you
stalk.successText: You bag a fat bog hare.
stalk.perfectText: Not one reed stirred. You bag a hare and spot a glint of wisp-glass in the mud.
stalk.failText: A heron shrieks, the hares scatter and the reeds go still.

mortar.title: The Hive Mortar
mortar.subtitle: Balance heat, moisture and bitterness while you rest
mortar.perfectText: A flawless remedy! The Sisters would approve.

astragaloi.title: Augury Bones
astragaloi.subtitle: Cast the Hive Mother's four bones

shield_clash.title: Shield Clash
shield_clash.subtitle: Brace at the moment of impact

transcript.speaker: World Consequence
transcript.text: Tamsin Quill falls among her spilled ribbons and lamp oil. The Quill & Candle is shuttered and the Watch starts asking questions.

scheduleEvent.title: Curfew on the Ford
scheduleEvent.text: The Watch rings the ferry bell three times: curfew on the ford until the killer is found.

addJournalChronicle.title: Murder at the Quill & Candle
addJournalChronicle.text: Tamsin Quill was killed. Her shop is closed for good.

transcript.speaker: World Consequence
transcript.text: Examiner Odile Marsh is dead. Without an examiner the Guild trials are over, and the Guild will not forget who ended them.

addJournalChronicle.title: The Examiner Falls
addJournalChronicle.text: Odile Marsh was killed. The Trial Ledger is void.

transcript.speaker: World Consequence
transcript.text: Captain Hob Garrow goes down in the mud of his own ford. The Watch will never forgive this, but the smugglers of Saltreed raise a glass.

addJournalChronicle.title: Death of Captain Garrow
addJournalChronicle.text: The captain of the Ford Watch was killed. His lighthouse key is with his belongings.
